rule: Any change to a built visuals package other than the pin of a reviewed type-only dependency requires a version bump. Each released version has one legacy fingerprint (integrity, which courses declare; legacyBasis is the dependency map it was computed with, and the test re-derives it from the current dist bytes). A version recorded with an identity also has one package identity: every file under dist plus the parsed manifest in key order, minus the pins of its reviewed typeOnlyDependencies, which no dist file may refer to. test/released-digests.test.ts enforces both. Record new versions with: npm run digest

0.1.0.provenance: course-core-visuals-0.1.0.tgz shipped identically with Core v0.1.3 through v0.1.25. A rebuild of the v0.1.25 tree reproduces integrity and headless. No package identity is recorded: its declaration files were never fingerprinted.

0.1.1.provenance: React client wrapper ResizeObserver loop fix (dist/react.js only); headless runtime unchanged from 0.1.0. typeOnlyDependencies reviewed: src imports @course-core/sdk with import type only, and no runtime dist file names it; dist is byte-identical (declarations included) under SDK 0.2.0 and 0.5.0

0.2.0.provenance: Adds clip, mask, symbol/use and equation nodes, render-feature detection, a shared sanitized SVG markup builder (React view and headless renderSvg) and MathML text equivalents. The headless runtime changed; 0.1.x scenes evaluate and render exactly as in 0.1.1 (test/prior-parity.test.tsx). typeOnlyDependencies reviewed as for 0.1.1: src imports @course-core/sdk with import type only, and no runtime dist file names it.

0.3.0.provenance: Adds deterministic fixed-step springs, staggers, the four-layout set (compact, tabletPortrait, tabletLandscape, wide), synchronized table/code/formula panes and off-screen pause, with render-feature detection for each. 0.1.x and 0.2.0 scenes evaluate and render as before (test/prior-parity.test.tsx and the 0.2.0 snapshots in test/fixtures/primitives). typeOnlyDependencies reviewed as for 0.1.1.

0.4.0.provenance: Adds publish-time scene checks (invariants with probes into geometry and panes, golden frame digests), the parameter inspector and multi-device preview. 0.1.x, 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 scenes evaluate and render as before (test/prior-parity.test.tsx and the snapshots in test/fixtures). typeOnlyDependencies reviewed as for 0.1.1.

0.5.0.provenance: Adds image assets (embedded PNG/JPEG/WebP verified against their sha256), radial gradients, matrix and environment equations, path morph, colour tracks and a camera; export controls, device chrome in the preview, lazy loading and disposal, completion as an observation, and translatable messages (VisualMessages). 0.1.x to 0.4.0 scenes evaluate and render as before (test/prior-parity.test.tsx, the snapshots in test/fixtures and the 0.4 goldens). typeOnlyDependencies reviewed as for 0.1.1.

0.5.1.provenance: Changes only the React wrapper: a lazy player observes the container it scrolls in (the nearest vertically scrolling ancestor, or scrollRoot), so its preload margin works inside a scrolling lesson pane. The headless entry and every module it imports are byte-identical to 0.5.0 (same headless digest), so 0.5.0 scenes evaluate and render exactly as before. typeOnlyDependencies reviewed as for 0.1.1.

0.5.2.provenance: Moves every diagnostic into the error catalog: each VisualError, check failure and reference-check result carries a catalog key and parameters next to its unchanged English message, and the inspector shows errors through messages.describeError, so hosts can translate them. This changes the headless bytes (0.5.1 was byte-identical to 0.5.0; 0.5.2 is not), but not behaviour: test/v05-parity.test.tsx checks that every frame, React markup and headless SVG of the demo scenes, including the 0.5 primitives, equals what the 0.5.1 build produced. typeOnlyDependencies reviewed as for 0.1.1.

0.5.3.provenance: Stylesheet only: labels set in tracked capitals for Latin script (the eyebrow, pane headings and the controls legend) get a :lang(he) reset to normal letter-spacing and no case transform, because Hebrew has no capitals and tracking pulls its words apart; test/styles.test.ts fails on a rule without one. Every dist file except styles.css, and so the headless entry and every module it imports, is byte-identical to 0.5.2 (the same recorded headless digest). typeOnlyDependencies reviewed as for 0.1.1.

0.5.4.provenance: Stylesheet only: the scene is laid out in its own left-to-right coordinates in any page direction (direction: ltr on .ccv-scene, each label ordered by its own first letter), so a label anchored at its start no longer grows off the canvas in a right-to-left page; sliders run left to right with the scene; a control's value is one left-to-right unit. Every dist file except styles.css, and so the headless entry and every module it imports, is byte-identical to 0.5.3 and 0.5.2 (the same recorded headless digest). typeOnlyDependencies reviewed as for 0.1.1.

mislabeled.reason: Shipped the 0.1.1 React fix under the 0.1.0 version. Not a released identity of 0.1.0 and never accepted as one.
